citations.quote: My mother sleeps in that room and has had one sinus infection after another since spring.

In the bedroom, behind the wardrobe, the wall has turned black and furry, and over the summer this has crept up and along the ceiling; the room smells musty and clothes in the wardrobe smell the same.
Whether someone qualified now has to come and examine the wall to find out where the moisture comes from has not been decided; the caretaker said he would discuss that with the management.
I have read about paying the rent into the deposit account at the conciliation office, and if nothing happens by November, I will do that.

plan.because: Health effects are reported. Obtain the medical findings and any limits on the attributed cause; address immediate health or safety concerns first.
Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The caretaker inspected the wall, but the defect report to the landlord and its date are not documented.
Landlord receipt and its date are not evidenced.
Objective dated evidence of the affected areas is missing.
The caretaker's report and any management response, proposed work and access arrangements need documenting.
The reported mould activates the moisture and temperature evidence branch.
Heating is not mentioned and is presumed absent for planning under the silence policy.
Whether a specialist inspection is needed remains open; clarify before requesting it.
A rent deposit is being considered; any written repair deadline and its recipient must be checked before assessing safeguards.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: Is your mother experiencing urgent or worsening symptoms, and has she sought current medical advice?
When and how was the landlord notified of the defect, and is there proof of receipt or a written repair deadline?
Has management decided whether a qualified specialist needs to inspect the wall, and has an inspection already taken place?
When did the caretaker inspect, and what response, repair proposal or access arrangements have followed?
